items.name: Noah
clues: I obeyed God when no one understood me.
I spent years building a massive structure.
I gathered the animals two by two.
I built the ark to survive the flood.

items.name: Moses
clues: As a baby, I was rescued from the waters.
God spoke to me from a burning bush.
I led a people out of slavery.
I parted the Red Sea.

items.name: David
clues: I was a shepherd, the youngest in my family.
I played the harp to soothe a king.
I became king of Israel.
I defeated Goliath with a sling.

items.name: Jonah
clues: I fled God's call by boarding a ship.
A storm caused me to be cast into the sea.
I eventually preached to Nineveh.
I spent three days inside a great fish.

items.name: Adam
clues: I gave names to all the animals.
My companion was taken from my side.
I lived in the Garden of Eden.
I am the first man created.

items.name: Mary
clues: An angel came to visit me.
I was engaged to a carpenter.
I traveled to Bethlehem.
I am the mother of Jesus.

items.name: Daniel
clues: I refused the king's food.
I interpreted dreams and visions.
I read the writing that appeared on a wall.
I survived in the lion's den.

items.name: Abraham
clues: I left my country at God's command.
God promised me a great offspring.
I nearly sacrificed my son Isaac.
I am called the father of believers.

items.name: Samson
clues: My strength was a gift from God.
I never cut my hair.
Delilah betrayed me.
I brought down a temple on the Philistines.

items.name: Peter
clues: I was a fisherman by the shore of a lake.
I walked on water toward Jesus.
I denied Jesus three times.
Jesus entrusted me with the keys of the kingdom.

items.name: Eve
clues: I was formed from a rib.
A serpent spoke to me.
I ate from the forbidden fruit.
I am the first woman.

items.name: Joshua
clues: I was Moses' right hand.
I explored the land of Canaan.
I made walls fall by marching around them.
I led the people into the Promised Land.

items.name: Joseph
clues: My father gave me a remarkable coat.
My brothers sold me into slavery.
I interpreted dreams in Egypt.
I became governor of Egypt.

items.name: Elijah
clues: I announced a great drought.
Ravens fed me.
I faced the prophets of Baal on Mount Carmel.
I was taken to heaven in a chariot of fire.

items.name: Solomon
clues: I asked for wisdom rather than wealth.
I judged two women claiming the same child.
The queen of Sheba came to test me.
I built the temple of Jerusalem.

items.name: Ruth
clues: I came from a foreign land, Moab.
I followed my mother-in-law Naomi.
I gleaned in the fields of Boaz.
I am the great-grandmother of King David.

items.name: John the Baptist
clues: I lived in the wilderness.
I ate locusts and wild honey.
I baptized in the Jordan.
I baptized Jesus.

items.name: Esther
clues: An orphan, I was raised by my cousin.
I became queen of Persia.
I risked my life approaching the king.
I saved my people from a massacre.

items.name: Gideon
clues: An angel called me while I was threshing wheat.
I asked for a sign with a fleece.
I reduced my army to 300 men.
I defeated the Midianites.

items.name: Paul
clues: I persecuted Christians.
A light blinded me on the road.
I became an apostle to the nations.
I wrote many epistles.

items.name: Zacchaeus
clues: I was small in stature.
I was rich but unloved.
I collected taxes.
I climbed a sycamore tree to see Jesus.

items.name: Jacob
clues: I bought the birthright for a bowl of stew.
I saw a ladder to heaven in a dream.
I wrestled with God all night long.
My twelve sons became the tribes of Israel.

items.name: Martha
clues: I lived in Bethany.
I was busy with tasks while my sister listened to Jesus.
My brother fell sick and died.
Jesus raised my brother Lazarus from the dead.

items.name: Nehemiah
clues: I was cupbearer to the king of Persia.
I wept when I learned of my city's state.
I rebuilt the walls of Jerusalem.
A book of the Bible bears my name.

items.name: Deborah
clues: I judged Israel under a palm tree.
I am a prophetess.
I urged Barak to battle.
I sang a song of victory as judge of Israel.

items.name: Elisha
clues: I received a double portion of my master's spirit.
I made an iron axhead float.
I healed Naaman of leprosy.
I succeeded the prophet Elijah.

items.name: Nebuchadnezzar
clues: I dreamed of a great statue.
I threw three men into a burning furnace.
I ate grass like an ox.
As king of Babylon, I destroyed Jerusalem.

items.name: Rahab
clues: I lived in a city marked for destruction.
I hid two spies.
I tied a scarlet cord to my window.
I was spared when Jericho fell.

items.name: Nathan
clues: I was a prophet at the court of the king.
I told a parable about a little lamb.
I confronted King David about his sin.
I supported Solomon as his successor.

items.name: Stephen
clues: I was one of seven deacons.
I gave a long speech before the Sanhedrin.
I saw heaven opened before I died.
I am the first Christian martyr.

items.name: Hannah
clues: Barren, I wept in the temple.
The priest Eli thought I was drunk.
I promised my son to God.
I am the mother of Samuel.

items.name: Caleb
clues: I explored Canaan with eleven others.
I remained confident when the others were afraid.
Only Joshua and I believed the promise.
At 85 years old, I claimed my mountain.

items.name: Barnabas
clues: I sold a field for the apostles.
I was nicknamed "son of encouragement."
I traveled on missionary journeys with Paul.
I parted ways with Paul over Mark.

items.name: Jehoshaphat
clues: I was a faithful king of Judah.
I sent teachers of the Law throughout the land.
I won a battle through praise.
A valley bears my name.

items.name: Levi
clues: I sat at a tax collector's booth.
Jesus said to me, 'Follow me.'
I left everything to follow him.
I am better known by the name Matthew.

items.name: Melchizedek
clues: I am king of Salem.
I am priest of the Most High God.
I blessed Abraham and received a tithe from him.
The book of Hebrews compares me to Christ.

items.name: Jephthah
clues: Rejected by my brothers, I fled.
I was called back to lead the war.
I made a rash vow before the battle.
I had to sacrifice my only daughter.

items.name: Abigail
clues: My husband Nabal was harsh and senseless.
I brought provisions to appease David.
My wisdom prevented a massacre.
After Nabal's death, I married David.

items.name: Onesimus
clues: I was a runaway slave.
I met Paul while he was imprisoned.
My master was named Philemon.
An entire short letter speaks of me.

items.name: Shamgar
clues: I am a very obscure judge.
I had no army.
I struck down six hundred Philistines.
I used an ox goad as my weapon.

items.name: Jael
clues: I welcomed a fleeing general under my tent.
I gave him milk to make him sleep.
I struck him while he slept.
I drove a peg through Sisera's temple.

items.name: Epaphras
clues: I am mentioned in Paul's letters.
I struggled in prayer for my church.
I brought the Gospel to Colossae.
Paul calls me a faithful servant of Christ.

items.name: Ahithophel
clues: I was a highly trusted counselor of David.
My advice was regarded as the word of God.
I betrayed David by joining Absalom.
Despairing, I hanged myself.

items.name: Jabez
clues: My mother named me for the pain of my birth.
I am tucked into a genealogy.
I was more honored than my brothers.
I made a famous prayer to be blessed.

items.name: Dorcas
clues: I did much good and gave to the poor.
I sewed clothes for widows.
I fell sick and died in Joppa.
The apostle Peter raised me from the dead.

items.name: Ehud
clues: I was left-handed.
I brought a gift to the king of Moab.
I struck him with a hidden sword.
I delivered Israel from King Eglon.

items.name: Baruch
clues: I was secretary to a great prophet.
I wrote down his words from his dictation.
The king burned the scroll I had written.
I served the prophet Jeremiah.

items.name: Balaam
clues: I was paid to curse a people, yet I could only bless them.
A king of Moab sent for me from afar.
On the road, my donkey saw what I could not.
My donkey spoke to me to stop me.

items.name: Lydia
clues: My business dealt in royal purple.
The Lord opened my heart by a river.
I welcomed Paul and Silas into my home in Philippi.
I sold purple cloth, the first convert in Europe.

items.name: Cornelius
clues: I commanded a hundred Roman soldiers.
My prayers and alms have come up before God.
An angel told me to send for a man in Jaffa.
Peter came to my house, and my whole household believed.

items.name: Absalom
clues: My beauty was praised throughout Israel.
At the city gate, I stole the hearts of men.
I rebelled against my own father, the king.
My hair caught in a terebinth tree as I fled.

items.name: Hagar
clues: A servant, I fled to the wilderness from my mistress.
By a spring, Someone called me by name.
God opened my eyes to a well to save my son.
Servant of Sarah, I am the mother of Ishmael.

items.name: Mephibosheth
clues: A fall in childhood left me crippled in both feet.
I lived forgotten in Lodebar.
A king sought me out for love of my father.
Son of Jonathan, I ate at David's table.

items.name: Gehazi
clues: I served a great prophet.
I ran after a healed general to demand a gift.
I lied to my master on my return.
Naaman's leprosy clung to me forever.

items.name: Achan
clues: Because of me, Israel lost an easy battle.
I hid under my tent what was devoted to destruction.
A Babylonish cloak, silver, and gold destroyed me.
I was judged in the Valley of Achor, after Jericho fell.

items.name: Apollos
clues: I came from Alexandria and spoke with great eloquence.
At first, I knew only John's baptism.
A couple of tentmakers explained the way more accurately to me.
I watered what Paul had planted.

items.name: Athaliah
clues: I seized the throne by blood.
I destroyed nearly an entire royal line.
A child hidden six years in the temple caused my downfall.
Mother of King Ahaziah, I reigned over Judah.

items.name: Ananias
clues: The Lord called me in a vision, and I was afraid of the task.
I was sent to a man known for persecuting believers.
I went to the street called Straight, in Damascus.
I laid hands on Saul so he could see again.

items.name: Nicodemus
clues: I was a Pharisee and a ruler of the Jews, a teacher in Israel.
I came to ask Jesus questions at night, so no one would see.
I was told I must be born again, and I did not understand.
I brought myrrh and aloes to bury Jesus.

items.name: Timothy
clues: Faith was passed to me by my mother and grandmother.
My spiritual father wrote me two letters that bear my name.
I was advised to take a little wine for my stomach.
I was told: 'Let no one despise your youth.'

items.name: Silas
clues: I was chosen as a travel companion after a sharp dispute.
In the epistles, I am also called Silvanus.
I was beaten with rods and thrown in prison in Philippi.
At midnight, I sang praises to God when the earth shook.

items.name: Priscilla
clues: With my husband, we had to leave Rome by the emperor's decree.
We were tentmakers, like our apostle friend.
A church met in our home.
With Aquila, I explained God's way more accurately to Apollos.

items.name: Uriah
clues: A foreigner, I served faithfully in Israel's army.
Out of loyalty, I refused to sleep in my own home.
I carried the letter that ordered my own death.
King David took my wife, Bathsheba.

items.name: Jezebel
clues: A foreign princess, I brought my idols into Israel's palace.
I fed hundreds of the prophets of Baal at my table.
I orchestrated a false trial to get my husband a vineyard.
Thrown from a window, I was devoured by dogs, as Elijah said.

items.name: Hezekiah
clues: King of Judah, I smashed the idols, even Moses' bronze serpent.
Besieged by Assyria, I spread the threatening letter before the Lord.
Sick unto death, I wept, and God added fifteen years to my life.
For me, the shadow went back ten degrees on the sundial of Ahaz.

items.name: Josiah
clues: I became king of Judah at eight years old.
During temple repairs, the Book of the Law was found.
When I heard it read, I tore my clothes.
I celebrated a Passover like none seen since the judges.

items.name: Simeon
clues: I was waiting for the consolation of Israel, and the Spirit rested on me.
It had been revealed to me that I would not die before seeing the Christ.
Prompted by the Spirit, I went to the temple that day.
I took the child Jesus in my arms: 'My eyes have seen your salvation.'

items.name: Jeremiah
clues: Called as a young man, I answered: 'I do not know how to speak.'
God forbade me to marry, as a sign to my people.
I was lowered into a cistern full of mud to silence me.
I am called the weeping prophet; I wept over Jerusalem's fall.

items.name: Ezekiel
clues: I was a prophet among the exiles by the river Kebar.
I saw a chariot of glory with wheels full of eyes.
God made me lie on my side for many days as a sign to Israel.
In a valley, I saw dry bones come back to life.

items.name: Mordecai
clues: I raised my uncle's daughter as my own daughter.
Sitting at the king's gate, I uncovered a plot against him.
I refused to bow down to the king's favorite.
I was paraded on the royal horse by the man who wanted to hang me.

items.name: Hulda
clues: I am a woman, and kings sent to consult me.
I lived in Jerusalem, in the second quarter of the city.
Josiah's messengers came to see me after the scroll was found.
I announced judgment, but peace for the humble king.

items.name: Phinehas
clues: I am the grandson of Israel's first high priest.
My zeal stopped a plague striking the people at Baal Peor.
I acted with a spear when all wept at the tent entrance.
God gave me his covenant of peace and an eternal priesthood.

items.name: Zipporah
clues: My father was a priest of Midian.
A fugitive from Egypt defended the daughters at the well, and I married him.
Our sons were named Gershom and Eliezer.
On the road, I circumcised my son and spoke of an 'bridegroom of blood.'

items.name: Obed-Edom
clues: I am from Gath, yet my house was blessed by the God of Israel.
What caused another man's death remained in my home three months.
During that time, the Lord blessed everything that belonged to me.
Seeing this, David took heart to bring up the ark.

items.name: Uzzah
clues: I walked beside a cart drawn by oxen carrying a sacred object.
The oxen stumbled, and I reached out my hand.
I touched what no hand should touch.
I died there, and the place was called Perez-Uzzah.

items.name: Simon the Sorcerer
clues: In my city of Samaria, I was thought to be the power of God.
I believed Philip's preaching and was baptized.
I saw the Spirit given through the laying on of the apostles' hands.
I offered money for this power, and Peter rebuked me severely.

items.name: Eutychus
clues: I was a young man sitting on the edge of a window.
The preacher prolonged his message until midnight.
Overcome with sleep, I fell from the third story.
I was picked up dead, but Paul restored me to life.

items.name: Demas
clues: My name appears in the greetings of several epistles.
I was a fellow worker with Paul, along with Luke.
Then I loved the present world.
Paul writes that I abandoned him and went to Thessalonica.

items.name: Agabus
clues: I am a prophet who came down from Jerusalem to Antioch.
By the Spirit, I announced a great famine under Emperor Claudius.
Years later, I took an apostle's belt.
I bound his hands and feet with it to announce his arrest.

items.name: Barzillai
clues: I was a wealthy old man from Gilead, eighty years old.
I supplied King David when he was fleeing from his own son.
Invited to the palace, I declined: I wanted to die near my fathers.
I sent Chimham in my place to the king.

items.name: Nabal
clues: I was very rich in sheep and goats, in Maon.
My very name means 'fool,' and I acted like one.
I insulted David's men who had protected my shepherds.
My wife Abigail turned aside the sword; my heart became like stone.

items.name: Matthias
clues: I followed Jesus from John's baptism until the Ascension.
A witness of the resurrection was needed to complete the twelve.
I was presented with Joseph called Barsabbas.
After prayer, the lot fell on me.

items.name: Zerubbabel
clues: Descendant of David, I led the exiles back to Jerusalem.
I laid the foundations of the second temple.
I was told: 'Not by might, nor by power, but by My Spirit.'
Before me, the great mountain was to become a plain.

items.name: Cleopas
clues: That day, I was leaving Jerusalem, my heart heavy, with a companion.
A stranger joined us on the way and seemed to know nothing of the events.
He explained the Scriptures to us, and our hearts burned within us.
We recognized Him in the breaking of bread, in our village of Emmaus.
